home.title: Teaching Healthy Cultivation
home.intro: A connected learning system for plant science, cultivation practice, diagnosis, measurement, breeding and crop records. Start with a pathway or search the full encyclopedia.

groups.title: Start with the fundamentals
groups.text: Build the plant-science and measurement foundation before chasing isolated target numbers.

groups.title: Understand the living plant
groups.text: Explore anatomy, physiology, chemistry and the structures behind visible crop behavior.

groups.title: Run and troubleshoot a grow
groups.text: Connect environment, root-zone measurements, symptoms, IPM and repeatable records.

groups.title: Measure and document
groups.text: Use procedures, records and evidence controls so observations are comparable over time.

atlas.title: Atlas Learning Library
atlas.intro: Use the 3D Plant Atlas as the visual layer, then move into the encyclopedia lessons that explain how each structure works and why it matters in cultivation.

groups.title: Plant structure
groups.text: Roots, stems, nodes, leaves, meristems, flowers and trichomes.

groups.title: Whole-plant function
groups.text: Photosynthesis, transport, hormones, water relations and environmental response.

groups.title: Reproduction and chemistry
groups.text: Flowering, trichomes, cannabinoids, terpenes and reproductive biology.

start-here.title: Start Here
start-here.intro: A practical first route through cannabis cultivation education: understand the plant, establish a safe grow space, learn the measurements, then build repeatable crop records.

groups.title: 1 · Plant first
groups.text: Learn the major organs, lifecycle and why plant response—not folklore—anchors decisions.

groups.title: 2 · Environment
groups.text: Temperature, humidity, VPD, airflow, PPFD and DLI belong in one environmental picture.

groups.title: 3 · Root zone
groups.text: Learn media, oxygen, water quality, pH, EC and irrigation before diagnosing nutrition by sight.

groups.title: 4 · Observe and record
groups.text: Use repeatable observation, photos and measurement history so problems can be compared instead of guessed.

plant-health.title: Plant Health & IPM
plant-health.intro: Plant-health education organized around prevention, scouting, differential diagnosis, pest and disease biology, verification and documented outcomes.

groups.title: Diagnostic reasoning
groups.text: Separate symptoms from causes and build differentials before treatment.

groups.title: Pests and diseases
groups.text: Learn life cycles, damage patterns, disease development, testing and risk factors.

groups.title: IPM and biosecurity
groups.text: Prevention, quarantine, sanitation, scouting, thresholds, intervention context and follow-up.

cultivation-science.title: Cultivation Science
cultivation-science.intro: Study cultivation as interacting plant, environment, root-zone and management systems instead of isolated grow-room numbers.

groups.title: Environment + light
groups.text: Water relations, humidity, VPD, temperature, airflow, PPFD, DLI, spectrum and photoperiod.

groups.title: Roots + nutrition
groups.text: Media, rhizosphere, source water, nutrient availability, pH, EC, irrigation and diagnostics.

groups.title: Crop development
groups.text: Propagation, canopy architecture, flowering and harvest/postharvest decisions.

symptoms.title: Symptom Differentials
symptoms.eyebrow: Do not diagnose from one clue
symptoms.intro: Use visible symptoms as evidence to organize possibilities—not as proof. Compare where symptoms start, how they progress, root-zone measurements, environment, pest signs and crop history.

groups.title: Abiotic differentials
groups.text: Nutrition, pH/EC, water stress, temperature, light and root-zone conditions can overlap visually.

groups.title: Biotic differentials
groups.text: Pests, pathogens and viroids require organism-specific evidence, testing or characteristic signs where available.

groups.title: Record the evidence
groups.text: Preserve photos, affected tissue, plant position, timing, measurements, actions and outcomes.

beginner-guides.title: Beginner Guides
beginner-guides.intro: Beginner-friendly paths that connect each task to the underlying plant science and the measurements worth recording.

groups.title: From seed to established plant
groups.text: Seed biology, germination, seedling establishment and transplant readiness.

groups.title: Vegetative growth
groups.text: Root-zone management, environment, lighting, structure and canopy development.

groups.title: Flower through postharvest
groups.text: Floral development, crop observation, harvest, drying, curing and quality records.

sops.title: SOPs & Measurement
sops.intro: Reference procedures for collecting cultivation data with preserved units, instrument identity, calibration state, sample method, location and time.

groups.title: Environment and light
groups.text: Temperature/RH placement, VPD context, PPFD mapping, DLI and photoperiod records.

groups.title: Water and root zone
groups.text: pH, EC, source water, runoff, substrate moisture and irrigation records need defined sampling methods.

groups.title: Scouting and crop records
groups.text: Use stable observation categories, photos, denominators, locations and follow-up outcomes.

glossary.title: Cultivation Glossary
glossary.intro: Find cultivation and plant-science terms through the encyclopedia. Definitions stay connected to the lesson that explains the mechanism, measurement or limitation.

groups.title: Plant biology terms
groups.text: Anatomy, physiology, genetics, reproduction and secondary metabolism.

groups.title: Cultivation measurements
groups.text: VPD, PPFD, DLI, EC, pH, alkalinity, dryback, water activity and related units.

groups.title: Plant-health terms
groups.text: Symptoms, signs, incidence, severity, differential diagnosis, thresholds, IPM and biosecurity.

records.title: Printables & Records
records.intro: Use consistent records for spaces, plants, irrigation, feeding, measurements, scouting, harvest and breeding so later comparisons have context.

groups.title: Digital grow records
groups.text: GrowLens connects plants, cycles, environmental readings, irrigation, observations, photos and outcomes.

groups.title: Diagnostic records
groups.text: Capture symptoms, affected tissue, timing, environment/root-zone context, actions and follow-up outcome.

groups.title: Breeding and selection records
groups.text: Preserve parentage, generation, population, plant IDs, trait criteria and selection outcomes.

sources.title: Evidence & Sources
sources.intro: THC separates controlled observations, primary research, extension guidance, standards, equipment documentation and legal requirements. Use the source type that matches the question.

groups.title: Research literacy
groups.text: Learn how to evaluate experiments, generalization, confounding, measurement uncertainty and causal language.
links: How to Read Plant Science Critically

groups.title: Evidence limits
groups.text: Study conditions are not universal targets. Preserve genotype, stage, system, units, method and tested range.

groups.title: Traceability
groups.text: Source notes, revision control and exact identifiers make later corrections and updates possible.
